name: libyang
what_it_is: A YANG data modelling language parser and toolkit written in C, providing APIs for parsing, validating, and converting YANG schemas and instance data. It serves as a foundational library for projects such as libnetconf2, Netopeer2, and sysrepo.
components: yanglint — feature-rich CLI tool for YANG validation and data conversion (located in /tools/lint)
measurement: Built-in performance measurement tool included in the repository
Code coverage generation via ENABLE_COVERAGE CMake option
cmocka-based unit tests covering library behaviour
configuration: Build type: Release or Debug (Debug is default)
LIBYANG_EXTENSIONS_PLUGINS_DIR — runtime override for extensions plugins path
ENABLE_TESTS — enable unit tests in Release mode
modes: Library mode — embedded via C API (#include <libyang/libyang.h>)
CLI mode — interactive and non-interactive yanglint tool
devel branch — latest improvements and bugfixes
constraints: Windows: yanglint operates in non-interactive mode only
Windows: YANG date-time values with unspecified timezone are converted to UTC
Minimum cmake >= 2.8.12 on Unix, >= 3.22.0 on Windows
No built-in language bindings — Python, C++, and Rust bindings are separate projects
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml in the repository — no containerised sandbox provided
No fault injection or error simulation facilities documented
No built-in language bindings (Python, C++, Rust available as separate repos)
No NETCONF/RESTCONF transport layer — libyang handles schema/data only; networking is left to libnetconf2/Netopeer2
